claim: Produces an executed cutover plan: named predecessor/destination with sole-writer terminal, dependency inventory, backfill, traffic cut, retirement, evidence, and residuals.

baseline.prompt: Write cutover.md planning how to replace an old payment API with a new one and remove the old path. Cover what must move, how traffic switches, and how you know it is done.

tasks.description: Fresh-context agent with the full procedure produces the cutover plan elements.
tasks.prompt: Read ./SKILL.md completely, then write cutover.md for replacing the legacy payment API ('pay-legacy') with the destination 'pay-v2' as sole writer. Follow the workflow: name the cut (predecessor, destination, traffic/data surface, terminal), dependency inventory, backfill with original oracles, cut traffic with new writes blocked, retire the predecessor, and prove destination ownership. Output: cutover plan executed, evidence, residuals.

tasks.description: Fresh-context baseline (no skill): same task, same cutover oracle.
